items.title: Geometric embedding of Borcherds-Bozec enveloping algebras into classical motivic semi-derived Hall algebras
items.author: Xinyi Feng; Fan Xu
items.difficulty_reason: The geometric enveloping-algebra realization requires motivic Hall stacks for two-periodic complexes of nilpotent quiver representations, acyclic localization/reduced quotient, a triangular decomposition and quantum Borcherds-Bozec realization, a controlled t=-1 classical limit, and constructible stratified Krull-Schmidt arguments for indecomposable generators. Original finite-quiver (allowing loops) and category assumptions retained; this is an independent main algebra construction beyond the old commutation support corollary.
